project.name: Return App (VB Exports)
project.description: High-throughput marketplace return reconciliation system, warehouse inward scanning, dispute claim automation bot, and operational inventory tracker for VB Exports.

nodes.name: Inward Scanning & Verification
nodes.label: Inward Scanning & Verification
nodes.summary: Physical warehouse receiving, barcode detection, AWB deduplication, item condition grading, and scan register recording.

businessRules: A duplicate AWB already received in an account cannot be scanned again without explicit supervisor warning
Physical scan keeps an immutable snapshot of all matched lines at scan time
Scans must be bound to the signed-in operator's assigned account scope

nodes.name: Claims Dispute Automation
nodes.label: Claims Dispute Automation
nodes.summary: Creation of dispute claims, unboxing video/photo evidence capture, supplier panel bot filing, and 48h ticket follow-up reconciliation.

businessRules: Claims require unboxing video evidence and photo documentation before submission
Desktop agent bot files tickets across isolated browser sessions with strict crash guards
Follow-up checks occur every 48 hours until claim is approved, rejected, or reconciled

nodes.name: Marketplace Return Reconciliation
nodes.label: Marketplace Return Reconciliation
nodes.summary: Multi-channel return report upload, header mapping, staged validation preview, and atomic lookup dataset activation.

businessRules: Superseded lookup rows are archived, never deleted
Only scannable rows activate into lookup groups; non-scannable remain in upload history
Upload previews expire from staging memory after 15 minutes

nodes.name: Ironing Operations & Logistics
nodes.label: Ironing Operations & Logistics
nodes.summary: Warehouse internal logistics tracking garments dispatched to and received from the ironing department.

businessRules: Only Inward Team or Admin role can record ironed units received
Real-time sync broadcast over WebSocket /api/live with fallback polling

nodes.name: OMSGuru Master Catalog Bridge
nodes.label: OMSGuru Master Catalog Bridge
nodes.summary: Nightly synchronization bridging active channel listings with the 120k+ product master catalog and caching image assets.

businessRules: Product master batched import processes up to 500 rows per transaction with pause/retry
Listing-to-master bridge maps active SKUs and backfills catalog thumbnails

nodes.name: Scan & Verify Return Package
nodes.label: Scan & Verify Return Package
nodes.summary: End-to-end flow of an incoming parcel from barcode scan to permanent register insertion.

nodes.name: File Automated Marketplace Claim
nodes.label: File Automated Marketplace Claim
nodes.summary: Flow from claim ticket creation to automated desktop bot filing and status tracking.

nodes.name: Upload Return Report & Activate
nodes.label: Upload Return Report & Activate
nodes.summary: Staged ingestion, error validation, preview review, and database activation of marketplace report.

nodes.name: Barcode Input or Camera Scan
nodes.label: Barcode Input or Camera Scan
nodes.summary: Operator scans AWB tracking number via Android CameraX scanner or desktop barcode scanner.

nodes.name: Active Lookup & Duplicate Check
nodes.label: Active Lookup & Duplicate Check
nodes.summary: System queries active lookup tables and prior scan ledger to verify authenticity and duplicate status.

nodes.name: Garment Condition & Defect Tagging
nodes.label: Garment Condition & Defect Tagging
nodes.summary: Operator inspects garment, verifies expected SKU, notes any defects, and attaches issue codes.

nodes.name: Commit to Register & Broadcast
nodes.label: Commit to Register & Broadcast
nodes.summary: Atomic PostgreSQL transaction writes scan row, items, issues, and broadcasts live event via WebSocket.

nodes.name: Capture Photo & Unboxing Video
nodes.label: Capture Photo & Unboxing Video
nodes.summary: Operator records 480p unboxing video and captures shipping label + defective item photos.

nodes.name: Unified Claim Creation & Queue Job
nodes.label: Unified Claim Creation & Queue Job
nodes.summary: System creates claim record and enqueues claim_automation_jobs row for desktop bot lease.

nodes.name: Desktop Bot Panel Filing
nodes.label: Desktop Bot Panel Filing
nodes.summary: Desktop engine leases job, launches supplier panel browser session, fills form, uploads media, and submits dispute.

nodes.name: 48-Hour Ticket Status Check
nodes.label: 48-Hour Ticket Status Check
nodes.summary: Engine re-checks ticket ID every 2 days until approved or reimbursed, updating claims ledger.
